summary: Plantain roasted over charcoal until smoky and charred, traditionally eaten with roasted peanuts or a fiery pepper sauce.
story: Boli, also called bole, is roasted plantain, a popular roadside food in Port Harcourt and elsewhere in southern Nigeria. It is traditionally sold hot from a charcoal grill and eaten with groundnuts or a spicy fish and pepper sauce.

steps.title: Prepare the plantain
steps.text: Peel the plantains, or score the skins lengthwise and leave them on for a smokier result. Brush peeled plantains with a little oil.

steps.title: Heat the grill
steps.text: Light charcoal and wait until the coals are glowing with a thin ash. Alternatively use a grill pan, or an oven at 230°C with the grill setting on.

steps.title: Roast
steps.text: Place the plantains on the grill and turn every 3 to 4 minutes. Cook 20 to 25 minutes until the skin is charred in patches and the flesh gives when pressed. The aroma should be sweet and smoky.

steps.title: Check for doneness
steps.text: Press the thickest part with a finger: it should yield softly, and the skin or surface should be blistered with dark char marks. If the outside is black but the middle is firm, move the plantain to a cooler part of the grill for 5 more minutes.

steps.title: Make the sauce
steps.text: Warm the palm oil in a pan, add the onion and fry for 2 minutes. Stir in the chilli, crayfish and salt and cook another minute until fragrant and slightly thick.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Remove any burnt skin if you like and cut the plantain into thick pieces. Serve hot with the pepper sauce and roasted peanuts.

tips: Turn often. Plantain sugars scorch quickly over strong heat.
Half-ripe plantain gives firmer boli with a mild sweetness; very ripe gives a soft, sweet one.
Press the plantain lightly to check doneness.
Roast in the skins for the most smoke flavour.

swaps.swap: Use a gas grill or an oven grill on high. You lose some smokiness, so add a pinch of smoked paprika to the sauce.
Use groundnut oil with cayenne and onion if you cannot find palm oil.

name: Boli (Roasted Plantain)
